purpose: Freeze one source-based management translation and two deterministic execution-assumption scenarios before the August 24-September 4 account panel, without changing Micro-v0.1 or using retrospective P&L to choose a rule.

management_rule.initial_stop: unchanged Micro plan stop; never widen
management_rule.first_target: actual confirmed average entry fill plus two times initial per-share risk
management_rule.first_target_action: after a confirmed target fill, realize one half and move only the remainder stop to the actual confirmed average entry fill
management_rule.runner_action: exit the remainder on the first completed one-minute red candle or the active stop, whichever becomes executable first
management_rule.unresolved_behavior: retain explicitly unresolved; do not invent a session-close mark or fill
selection_basis: Current normative training explicitly permits realizing half at the first target while retaining a runner.
The primary current full-training example explicitly teaches the completed red candle on a one-minute chart.
The one-minute choice is source-explicit and was fixed despite not being the least-negative July account cell.
management_rule.claim_boundary: This is one conservative machine translation for prospective testing, not a claim that Ross always uses it or that it is profitable.

execution_semantics.fill_price: causal displayed contra top-of-book price when it crosses the order limit
execution_semantics.partial_fill_cap: floor of displayed contra size times fixed scenario participation fraction

scenario_reporting: Report the primary and stress outcomes separately on the same prospective opportunity set; do not choose the better result.

fee_schedule.aggregation: sum each fee type by account-day then round each type up to the nearest cent
fee_schedule.taf_cap_application: apply the cap to each sell trade before account-day aggregation
fee_schedule.account_plan_caveat: Zero direct API equity commission is a research assumption for the direct commission-free API arrangement and must be reconciled against the actual account agreement or statement before any economic claim.

prospective_panel.missing_quote_or_halt_state_behavior: retain unavailable execution; never fall back to the frozen SIP print fill

limitations: Top-of-book size is not queue position and is haircut only as a fixed engineering assumption.
The model does not reconstruct venue routing, hidden liquidity, market impact, exchange acknowledgements, or broker-specific smart routing.
The two latency, participation, and limit-offset scenarios are uncalibrated assumptions and cannot be fitted from July outcomes.
Nasdaq TotalView is a single-venue depth source and cannot establish consolidated national depth.
Complete discretionary seller, tape, topping-tail, buying-slowdown, add, re-entry, and cross-account attention logic remains outside this child.
next_gate: Run the metadata-only Databento entitlement and exact-cost quote. If it passes below the fixed ceiling, request separate review before one bounded four-case data download; independently retain the scheduled prospective account snapshots and causal quote inputs.
